items.text: Vikings WRs Justin Jefferson (ankle) and Jordan Addison (hamstring) both Q; will workout pregame. Jefferson determined to play in Louisiana homecoming.
items.why: Limited practices; pregame tests decisive. Jefferson motivated.
items.implication: High-stakes monitor; both or one could sit. Hockenson volume spikes if either out.
items.opportunity: If OUT, T.J. Hockenson and remaining WR see massive target share.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (foot), listed questionable for SNF, is expected to play vs Falcons.
items.why: Schefter sources confirm expected despite Q designation.
items.implication: Start Flowers; maintains primary WR role with Lamar out.
items.opportunity: Full snap/route share expected opposite Huntley.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot), listed questionable after no practice this week, is not expected to play vs Broncos.
items.why: Did not practice all week with foot injury; Schefter sources confirm unlikely.
items.implication: Sit McConkey; LAC WR room thins significantly.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston and other LAC WRs see increased routes/targets.

items.text: Steelers RB Rico Dowdle (toe, Q) unlikely to play vs Colts; final determination in pregame warmups.
items.why: Toe injury; Schefter sources lean out pending warmups.
items.implication: Sit Dowdle; Jaylen Warren locked-in lead back.
items.opportunity: Jaylen Warren elevated snaps/carries/red-zone (already high share).

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (plantar fasciitis flare + ankle) hopeful to play but not definite; will workout pregame. LV elevated RB Roman Hemby as contingency.
items.why: Missed late-week practice; pregame workout to determine.
items.implication: Monitor warmups closely; high variance for Jeanty owners.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated Hemby or other backup inherits lead role/carries.

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed him Saturday morning he will be inactive vs Lions as details finalized. Texans remain primary team to watch; deal not complete until after Sunday games.
items.why: Trade finalizing; team informed player of inactive status Saturday AM.
items.implication: Zero fantasy production Week 5; long-term landing spot TBD (HOU favored). Opens ARI targets.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson and Trey McBride primary beneficiaries in ARI passing game; Kendrick Bourne elevated role.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) expected to play vs Vikings.
items.why: Source confirms expected despite back issue.
items.implication: Start Kamara with confidence in lead role.
items.opportunity: Full carries/targets expected.

items.text: Patriots RB Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) expected to play.
items.why: Source confirms expected.
items.implication: Start Stevenson; maintains RB1 role.
items.opportunity: Full workload.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) officially OUT Week 5; week-to-week, not on IR. Will Shipley primary with Dameon Pierce elevated for depth.
items.why: Hamstring from prior week; confirmed OUT on final reports.
items.implication: Sit Barkley; committee or Shipley lead.
items.opportunity: Will Shipley inherits majority snaps/carries/goal-line.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels fully active/return vs Giants; 'full go' no restrictions per OC. Diggs OUT (hamstring); McLaurin Q.
items.why: Elbow recovered; full practice participation and coach confirmation.
items.implication: Start Daniels; offense upgrades without Diggs.
items.opportunity: McLaurin (if active) or elevated WRs/TEs see targets with Daniels mobility back.

items.text: Confirmed OUTs: Breece Hall (quad, Jets), DeVonta Smith (hamstring, Eagles), Stefon Diggs (hamstring, WAS). Michael Pittman to IR (foot).
items.why: Final reports and Schefter/Rapoport confirmations; Pittman re-aggravation to IR.
items.implication: Sit all; handcuffs/backups elevated.
items.opportunity: Braelon Allen full Jets RB work; Eagles WRs/TE (Goedert/Wicks); WAS secondary WRs; PIT Roman Wilson No. 2.

items.text: Bengals Ja'Marr Chase (concussion protocol) and Tee Higgins (groin/neck) both QUESTIONABLE; full Friday practices lean active but monitor. Chase Brown volume secure either way.
items.why: Chase still in protocol; Higgins dual issues. Full Friday participation positive.
items.implication: Game-time; if either/both out, Meyers/Gesicki upside. Brown unaffected.
items.opportunity: Chase Brown receiving work holds; secondary WRs if Chase/Higgins sit.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) OUT; Tyler Huntley starts. Berry notes clear downgrade but 'for our purposes it doesn't really matter' re: some Ravens skill players.
items.why: Ankle sprain; ruled out earlier in week.
items.implication: Sit Lamar; Huntley lower ceiling, more run-heavy possible.
items.opportunity: Derrick Henry/Isaiah Likely usage may hold or rise; Flowers still viable.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert active return after knee absence (full Friday); upgraded in tiers to TE14. Smith/Barkley OUT boosts his target share.
items.why: Knee recovered; full participant, no designation. Smith OUT (hamstring).
items.implication: Strong TE start; 8-10+ target upside in thinned WR room.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/red-zone with Smith and Barkley absent.

items.text: MHJ had only 5 catches in 4 games and was not a real factor in any Michael Wilson stuff. With inactive/trade: 'Kia Kendrick Bourne szn'.
items.why: Low MHJ production (5/4 games); Wilson already independent; Bourne next man up post-inactive.
items.implication: Wilson remains startable; Bourne speculative upside in ARI.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes/targets hold or rise; Bourne sees expanded role.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown this week (usage/matchup); nickname 'Brown Gobbler' for gobbling targets/fantasy points. RB love list standout.
items.why: High target share + strong matchup; consistent fantasy production.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex start; volume secure even with Chase Q.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries + receiving work.

items.text: Berry Love list: Nico Collins WR8 vs TEN (volume/RZ); Michael Wilson WR10 vs DET (post-MHJ inactive boost). Also Watson WR15, Likely TE5.
items.why: Target hogs + favorable matchups/defenses soft vs WR/TE; Wilson volume post-MHJ news.
items.implication: Prioritize starts for Collins/Wilson; Likely upside with Lamar out.
items.opportunity: High target/route shares confirmed.

items.text: Berry Hate: Jordan Addison (tough matchup/role), Mark Andrews (usage/thin with Huntley), plus Skattebo/Pollard/Hurts fades.
items.why: Tough matchups, reduced roles, or QB downgrade impact.
items.implication: Sit or fade these; prefer alternatives.
items.conflict: Addison GTD status may override if Jefferson also sits.
